ExpressionAttributeNames: DynamoDB command input: the alias each attribute is written as
IndexName: DynamoDB command input: which secondary index
Item: DynamoDB command input: the attributes to write
Key: DynamoDB command input: the key attributes that pick an item
KeyConditionExpression: DynamoDB query input: which key attributes the query filters on
Keys: DynamoDB batch input: the keys a batch read asks for
ProjectionExpression: DynamoDB command input: which attributes to read
RequestItems: DynamoDB command input: the tables a batch or transaction touches
reference: suss: what a reader says instead of a name when the name is somewhere else
send: @aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb: the client method a command goes to
